text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

translations.asad: CONSIDER this unfolding [of God’s message], as it comes down from on high!
translations.sahih: By the star when it descends,

translations.asad: This fellow-man of yours has not gone astray, nor is he deluded,
translations.sahih: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

translations.asad: and neither does he speak out of his own desire:
translations.sahih: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

translations.asad: that [which he conveys to you] is but [a divine] inspiration with which he is being inspired –
translations.sahih: It is not but a revelation revealed,

translations.asad: something that a very mighty one has imparted to him:
translations.sahih: Taught to him by one intense in strength -

translations.asad: [an angel] endowed with sur­passing power, who in time manifested himself in his true shape and nature,
translations.sahih: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

translations.asad: appearing in the horizon’s loftiest part,
translations.sahih: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

translations.asad: and then drew near, and came close,
translations.sahih: Then he approached and descended

translations.asad: until he was but two bow-lengths away, or even nearer.
translations.sahih: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

translations.asad: And thus did [God] reveal unto His servant whatever He deemed right to reveal.
translations.sahih: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.

translations.asad: The [servant’s] heart did not give the lie to what he saw:
translations.sahih: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

translations.asad: will you, then, contend with him as to what he saw?
translations.sahih: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

translations.asad: And, indeed, he saw him a second time
translations.sahih: And he certainly saw him in another descent

translations.asad: by the lote-tree of the farthest limit,
translations.sahih: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

translations.asad: near unto the garden of promise.
translations.sahih: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -

translations.asad: with the lote-tree veiled in a veil of nameless splendour….
translations.sahih: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

translations.asad: [And withal,] the eye did not waver, nor yet did it stray:
translations.sahih: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

text.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ

translations.asad: truly did he see some of the most profound of his Sustainer’s symbols.
translations.sahih: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

translations.asad: HAVE YOU, then, ever considered [what you are worshipping in] Al-Lat and Al-Uzza,
translations.sahih: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?

translations.asad: as well as [in] Manat, the third and last [of this triad]?
translations.sahih: And Manat, the third - the other one?

translations.asad: Why - for yourselves [you would choose only] male offspring, whereas to Him [you assign] female:
translations.sahih: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

translations.asad: that, lo and behold, is an unfair division!
translations.sahih: That, then, is an unjust division.

text.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

translations.asad: These [allegedly divine beings] are nothing but empty names which you have invented - you and your forefathers - [and] for which God has bestowed no warrant from on high. They [who worship them] follow nothing but surmise and their own wishful thinking - although right guidance has now indeed come unto them from their Sustainer.
translations.sahih: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

translations.asad: Does man imagine that it is his due to have all that he might wish for,
translations.sahih: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

translations.asad: despite the fact that [both] the life to come and this present [one] belong to God [alone]?
translations.sahih: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

text.arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ

translations.asad: For, however many angels there be in the heavens, their intercession can be of no least avail [to anyone] - except after God has given leave [to inter­cede] for whomever He wills and with whom He is well-pleased.
translations.sahih: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

translations.asad: Behold, it is [only] such as do not [really] believe in the life to come that regard the angels as female beings;
translations.sahih: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

text.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا

translations.asad: and [since] they have no knowledge whatever thereof, they follow nothing but surmise: yet, behold, never can surmise take the place of truth.
translations.sahih: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

text.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

translations.asad: Avoid thou, therefore, those who turn away from all remembrance of Us and care for no more than the life of this world,
translations.sahih: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

text.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

translations.asad: which, to them, is the only thing worth knowing. Behold, thy Sustainer is fully aware as to who has strayed from His path, and fully aware is He as to who follows His guidance.
translations.sahih: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

text.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

translations.asad: Indeed, unto God belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth: and so He will reward those who do evil in accordance with what they did, and will reward those who do good with ultimate good.
translations.sahih: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

translations.asad: As for those who avoid the [truly] grave sins and shameful deeds - even though they may some­times stumble behold, thy Sustainer is abounding in forgiveness. He is fully aware of you when He brings you into being out of dust, and when you are still hidden in your mothers’ wombs: do not, then, consider your­selves pure - [for] He knows best as to who is conscious of Him.
translations.sahih: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

translations.asad: HAST THOU, then, ever considered him who turns away [from remembering Us, and cares for no more than the life of this world],
translations.sahih: Have you seen the one who turned away

translations.asad: and gives so little [of himself for the good of his soul], and so grudgingly?
translations.sahih: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

translations.asad: Does he [claim to] have knowledge of some­thing that is beyond the reach of human perception, so that he can see [it clearly]?
translations.sahih: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

text.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

translations.asad: Or has he never yet been told of what was [said] in the revelations of Moses,
translations.sahih: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

translations.asad: and of Abra­ham, who to his trust was true:
translations.sahih: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

translations.asad: that no bearer of burdens shall be made to bear another’s burden;
translations.sahih: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

text.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

translations.asad: and that nought shall be accounted unto man but what he is striving for;
translations.sahih: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

translations.asad: and that in time [the nature of] all his striving will be shown [to him in its true light],
translations.sahih: And that his effort is going to be seen -

translations.asad: where­upon he shall be requited for it with the fullest requital;
translations.sahih: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense

translations.asad: and that with thy Sustainer is the beginning and the end [of all that exists];
translations.sahih: And that to your Lord is the finality

translations.asad: and that it is He alone who causes [you] to laugh and to weep;
translations.sahih: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

translations.asad: and that it is He alone who deals death and grants life;
translations.sahih: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

translations.asad: and that it is He who creates the two kinds - the male and the female –
translations.sahih: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

translations.asad: out of a [mere] drop of sperm as it is poured forth,
translations.sahih: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

translations.asad: and that [therefore] it is within His power to bring about a second life;
translations.sahih: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation

translations.asad: and that it is He alone who frees from want and causes to possess;
translations.sahih: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

translations.asad: and that it is He alone who sustains the bright­est star;
translations.sahih: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

translations.asad: and that it is He who destroyed the ancient [tribes of] Ad
translations.sahih: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad

translations.asad: and Thamud, leaving no trace [of them],
translations.sahih: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -

text.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

translations.asad: as well as the people of Noah before them - [since,] verily, they all had been most willful in their evildoing and most overweening –
translations.sahih: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

translations.asad: just as He thrust into perdition those cities that were overthrown
translations.sahih: And the overturned towns He hurled down

translations.asad: and then covered them from sight forever.
translations.sahih: And covered them by that which He covered.

translations.asad: About which, then, of thy Sustainer’s powers canst thou [still] remain in doubt?
translations.sahih: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

translations.asad: THIS IS a warning like those warnings of old:
translations.sahih: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.

translations.asad: that [Last Hour] which is so near draws ever nearer,
translations.sahih: The Approaching Day has approached.

text.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

translations.asad: [although] none but God can unveil it....
translations.sahih: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.

translations.asad: Do you, perchance, find this tiding strange?
translations.sahih: Then at this statement do you wonder?

translations.asad: And do you laugh instead of weeping,
translations.sahih: And you laugh and do not weep

translations.asad: and divert yourselves all the while?
translations.sahih: While you are proudly sporting?

translations.asad: [Nay,] but prostrate yourselves before God, and worship [Him alone]!
translations.sahih: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
